Chapter 387: Chapter 8: A Trap? Figure It Out First (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 387: Chapter 8: A Trap? Figure It Out First (Subscribe Please)

By now, Lin Yuan’s Inner World had achieved Perfection, both his Physical Soul had reached Perfection.

The only thing hindering Lin Yuan from stepping into the Eighth Layer was his Spirit Will.

Yet, Spirit Will was very difficult to cultivate directly.

Lin Yuan’s worst-case scenario plan was to experience one or two more transits.

By utilizing the different flow of time between the transit worlds and the Main World, he intended to undergo a great expanse of time to temper his Spirit Will.

But now.

...

Feeling the immense Psychic Will Pressure emanating from that segment of the body.

Lin Yuan was not shocked but rather overjoyed.

This was a natural place to forge one’s Spirit Will.

“While tempering my Spirit Will, I shall also comprehend that segment of the body…”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the segment. It resembled a chunk of Hei Yu, the skin a light black hue, certain parts revealing muscles and deep purple-colored blood.

As Lin Yuan delved deeper into observation, in his vision, the body began to magnify, and countless runes appeared on the surface of the skin, the body of a Supreme Being, imprinted with the essence of the paths it had taken.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan saw an ocean-like flow of runes,

[Your insight defies the heavens, observing the mysterious body, you begin to comprehend the first Evolution Path…]

…

[Your insight defies the heavens, observing the mysterious body, you begin to comprehend the fifth Evolution Path…]

…

[Your insight defies the heavens, observing the mysterious body, you begin to comprehend the twentieth Evolution Path…]

…

[Your insight defies the heavens, observing the mysterious body, you begin to comprehend the fiftieth Evolution Path…]

…

“So many Evolution Paths?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised. Having observed just under an hour, and less than one-millionth of that segment of the body, he had glimpsed over a thousand Evolution Paths from it.

This was simply inconceivable.

How many Evolution Paths did this segment of body contain?

What if it were the complete body?

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan discontinued his contemplation.

Gao Wufeng and Zuo Qiuguang approached.

“It’s just too unbelievable,” Gao Wufeng shook his head, “I’ve already perceived the beginning of an Evolution Path from this segment of the body.”

“I feel that this Evolution Path is at least Eighth Layer, perhaps even Ninth Rank or Tenth Rank, and it suits me incredibly well… Comprehending the beginning posed no difficulty at all, with absolutely no obstruction…”

Gao Wufeng’s eyes blazed with fervor.

He even felt that the Evolution Path he was comprehending might be that ultimate Evolution Path.

“Me too.”

“I feel that some of the Evolution Paths within the body resonate deeply with me, as if they were specifically waiting for someone like me…”

Zuo Qiuguang spoke with a tone of excitement as well.

Besides the two of them, at the summit of this mountain, the other Evolvers all wore excited expressions, clearly having reaped beneficial insights, gaining what they sought.

“Shisan Peak Master, what about you?” Gao Wufeng looked towards Lin Yuan.

“I have some gains as well,” Lin Yuan said calmly, but his eyes betrayed a hint of puzzlement.

It was too easy.

Far too easy.

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept across and noticed that not only the Evolvers on this mountain but also many on other mountains seemed to have reaped significant benefits.

This was quite inconceivable.

Could it be that this segment of the body offered no threshold for comprehension?

And the Evolvers capable of appearing here all had significant backgrounds and high standards; an Evolution Path that excited them to such an extent would need to be at least Eighth Rank, perhaps even Ninth Rank or Tenth Rank.

Could the Evolution Paths contained within this body be of such high quality?

It should be noted that Human Civilization has recorded countless Evolution Paths, but finding ones that reach Eighth Rank or Tenth Rank is extremely rare.

And they simply comprehended them from the body?

…

A day later.

Lin Yuan, Gao Wufeng, and Zuo Qiuguang gathered together once more.

“I’ve already begun to cultivate,” Gao Wufeng stated outright, “The more I cultivate, the less Psychic Will Pressure I have to endure. It seems the direction I have chosen is the correct one.”

While observing and comprehending the segment of the body, they all had to endure the Psychic Will Pressure that it emitted.

This was something not only Lin Yuan felt, but other Evolvers felt as well.

However, based on what Gao Wufeng said, one could conclude that the Psychic Will Pressure was not constant and it would decrease with the cultivation of the comprehended Evolution Path.

“Me too.”

Zuo Qiuguang’s brows furrowed slightly, an untraceable frown. She had thought this sensation was unique to her.

But seeing that Gao Wufeng experienced the same, her thoughts immediately shifted.

“Shisan Peak Master, which Evolution Path have you chosen to cultivate?” Gao Wufeng looked toward Lin Yuan.

Upon saying this,

Zuo Qiuguang also turned her gaze to Lin Yuan.

In terms of talent and natural gifts, Lin Yuan was certainly above them.

If both of them had perceived the beginnings of an Evolution Path, it was impossible for Lin Yuan to have gained nothing.

“I’ll look a bit more,” Lin Yuan considered for a moment before responding.

The ease with which the other Evolvers discovered Evolution Paths had made Lin Yuan feel that something was off.

“Look some more?”

Zuo Qiuguang and Gao Wufeng exchanged glances,

both somewhat stunned.

There was only one seat for the throne of a Supreme Being.

At such a time, instead of rushing to cultivate, he wanted to continue exploring?

You should know that competing for the seat of a Supreme Being were not only fellow humans but also Different Species.

Every moment was exceedingly precious.

Gao Wufeng couldn’t help but urge, “Shisan Peak Master, if you do not choose to cultivate a certain Evolution Path, you’ll have to constantly suffer the suppression from Spirit Will. Under such pressure, even normal cultivation efficiency is greatly reduced. It’s completely unnecessary to do this.”

“Shisan Peak Master, are you perhaps spooked by those initial warnings and afraid to cultivate?” Zuo Qiuguang said from the side,

“My teacher told me to seize an opportunity when it arises. I am certain that although the Evolution Paths we have now perceived may have issues, if we halt our progress due to fear of problems, Human Civilization would probably still be on the mother planet right now.”
